messages.content: Interpret the supplied synthetic diplomatic utterance, not its presumed intent. x=weeks of OUR measure, y=weeks of THEIR reciprocal measure, cost=explicit resource expenditure. Use null for unstated numbers. Classify offer only if our measure is explicitly conditional on theirs and x in {1,2,3}, y in {1,2}. Negated offers, unless-conditions, unilateral promises, missing reciprocity and out-of-range terms are invalid; do not repair them. Query seeks conditions privately. Signal commits resources at a stated cost. Ambiguity makes the next proposal provisional. Ratify finalizes an accepted agreement. Withdraw exits talks. Return only the schema.

{"our_measure": "halt firing along the line of control", "their_measure": "halt firing along the line of control", "utterance": "If you halt firing along the line of control for 1 week, we will halt firing there for 3 weeks; our commitment depends on yours."}
